北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾且体感凉，出门记得戴口罩、添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy and feels cool. Remember to wear a mask and dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光好，但体感稍凉，记得适时添衣，享受好天气！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny but feels cool. Dress appropriately and enjoy the day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好，体感舒适。注意补水，保持水润哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant. Remember to hydrate and stay moisturized!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天气阴沉，湿度较大，体感舒适，记得带伞。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast with high humidity. It feels comfortable, but carry an umbrella!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天湿度高，体感温暖。出门记得带伞，别着凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast with high humidity, feels warm. Take an umbrella and don't catch a cold.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感偏凉干燥。多喝水，注意保湿哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but cool and dry. Drink more water and moisturize!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感有些凉意。记得添衣，多喝水，保持好心情！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but feels cool. Dress warmly, drink water, and stay cheerful!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温适宜，体感温暖。出门记得带把伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and warm. It feels pleasant. Remember to bring an umbrella!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光正好，但体感风凉，记得多穿衣，别着凉哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny but feels cool with wind. Dress warmly and avoid catching a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天，体感温暖但干燥。记得多喝水，滋润身体哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and warm but dry. Remember to drink plenty of water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阳光明媚，体感舒适温暖，是个适合出行的好天气！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and comfortably warm, a great day for going out!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感寒冷！风力不小，请务必多穿厚衣，注意保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels very cold! With considerable wind, please dress warmly to stay safe!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感寒冷，风力较大。出门多穿厚衣服，小心着凉！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels very cold with strong wind. Dress heavily when going out and avoid catching a cold!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感稍凉。出门别忘添衣，享受春城好时光！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers and enjoy the Spring City!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光正好，但体感微凉。多穿衣，海边风大，注意保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny but feels cool. Dress warmly, especially by the windy sea.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感寒冷，风不小。出门多穿厚衣，注意海边保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels very cold with considerable wind. Dress heavily, especially by the sea!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，气温较低。出门多穿厚衣，别让寒风吹着哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and cold. Dress warmly when you go out and don't let the cold wind get you!
